name: runhand
description: Simulation case creation, bounded tests, model comparisons, submission/retry, temporary-work cleanup, and situational reorientation.

interface.shortDescription: Create, test, compare, and submit simulations.
interface.longDescription: Creates simulation case variants, runs bounded checks in writable scratch, compares models using validated evidence, submits or retries prepared Runs, and cleans disposable work. Situational checks reconnect ongoing work to user intent after corrections or stalled progress. Simulator instructions supply scientific meaning and Site instructions supply execution and scheduler policy.
defaultPrompt: Create a new simulation run from the nearest precedent.
Try these simulation settings for 20 steps and check the result.
Compare these two models and check whether the result changes.
Preview cleanup of old RunHand scratch data.
